# A level without exits loses its sign's message when the editor saves it (851-3135; docs/quirks.md section 1).
# levels/s.lvl has no entrance or exit and one sign, HELLO, written in the loader's layout (exit count 0 and
# sign count 1 on lines of their own). F2, S and Enter (220-227) open it in the editor, which
# gives the sign its message; Escape and Y (240, 250) save it, and with no exit names the editor writes the
# two counts on one line, 01. F3, the first row and Enter (300-341) load it: scrLoadLevel reads one exit name
# (HELLO, which no exit takes) and no sign messages, so the sign has its default text. The player, with no
# entrance, starts at (24, 24). The window is 3x (screenScale 3).
